definitions.stage: Each episode source_stages counter: warmup_gaussian or sac_online; mixed/missing reported separately
definitions.clocks: source_updates in each receipt is AFTER that episode. BEFORE is previous completed episode source_updates; initial fresh learner0
definitions.nominal_states: initial_state_vector_sha256 is the requested nominal simulator vector, not a measured post-settle state
definitions.post_settle_states: Only explicit initial_simulator_state_sha256 counts as measured post-settle physical state; missing is unknown, not zero
definitions.recovery: An actually recorded failed episode followed by a later success within the same complete K4; optimizer and exploration may change between episodes
definitions.costs: Committed episode costs separated from total action charge;10 settling actions per episode from the qualified legacy contract
definitions.limits: Metadata-only, all40 train streams, no raw arrays/NN/tests/VLA compute, no semantic exclusions. Outcome counts do not establish expert quality, memory use or target transfer
